correctness.rationale: For every n>=1, published minimal-antisquare and heteroclinic propositions reduce periodic good binary words exactly to avoidance of eight finite factors. The cyclic Pansiot code bijection gives runs of zeros length >=2 and ones exactly 2 or 4, with even total ones and exactly two binary lifts; all-zero code contributes the two constant sequences. Counting m marked run boundaries gives P_n-2=2n sum_m [z^n]A(z)^m/m. Formal logarithms yield zeta=(1-z-z^4-z^6)^(-2), its exact recurrence, and Mobius inversion for primitive orbits. Independently, an exact 32-state transfer matrix satisfies det(I-zM)=(1-z-z^4-z^6)^2 via Newton identities, and all direct finite checks pass. No finite enumeration is used as an infinite proof.

The closed zeta, all-period recurrence, marked-run composition formula and orbit inversion collectively classify every finite period, including constants and nonprimitive lifts.
